title: Pydantic v2 schemas for the 3 transaction forms + DesignGradeReadWithCb
scope: 13 Pydantic v2 schemas: InwardCreate/LineCreate/Read/LineRead, SalesCreate/LineCreate/Read/LineRead, AdjustmentCreate/LineCreate/Read/LineRead, DesignGradeReadWithCb. Constraints per AC: design_id/grade_id gt=0; nos default None ge=0 (skip 0/None at service); physical_cb ge=0 (zero valid per AC-037); cross-field validator on AdjustmentCreate enforces stock_date <= entry_date (AC-035).

success_criteria.manual: Import all 13 schemas; validate AdjustmentCreate with stock_date > entry_date raises ValidationError.
success_criteria.automated: TC-052 (nos=-1), TC-061 (missing loading_staff), TC-067 (single design), TC-068 (stock>entry), TC-072 (physical=-1), TC-073 (physical=0 accepted) all pass.
success_criteria.definition_of_done: 13 schemas; model_validator on AdjustmentCreate; Read schemas have ConfigDict(from_attributes=True); place is NOT in any Create schema (derived server-side per DS-013).

checkout_prompt: '13 Pydantic schemas created; stock_date<=entry_date validator enforced.'
